complexity.convention: Whole standalone CPython 3.12.14 module; genuine docstrings removed; ast.unparse plus newline; significant tokens and all AST nodes; standard Python/JSON runtime excluded.

acceptance_contract: Normal process exit with exactly ACCEPT followed by a newline. Exceptions, nonzero exits, resource failures and other output reject. Unused certificate prefixes permitted; finite-proof completeness presumes adequate resources.
generic_ast_profile_limitation: Nonempty malformed strings can diverge with an ideal unlimited stack; concrete CPython rejects by its resource limit. Explicit-list profile has structurally finite raw syntax traversal.
review: Independent assistant review; not external human peer review or formal proof-assistant verification.
remaining_central_question: Can the weak self-seeded theory derive arbitrary successor cancellation, or can a full staged-recursion and equation-induction countermodel refute it?
